full_details: You brought the two fathers into the vault and gave the Friar forty lines to tell the living what they already know. You wrote the Prince's couplet and ruled it at a quarter past ten. The account book says Verona ended this day, and a pound of candles at fourpence. At the foot of the stair Mistress Ansell asked who was punished, and you said all of them. You were not at the Theatre's morning rehearsal. At Leadenhall you offered four shillings for a side of bacon and she refused the number. You carried a side, suet, a firkin of salt, onions on a string, and a cheese. You paid nothing toward the stores. Back in the close you took a turn with a sack. At two you played in The Two Gentlemen of Verona. At evening prayer you stood in your place and brought nothing out.
one_sentence: You ruled the last couplet at a quarter past ten, guessed four shillings for the bacon, and carried the house's coal.
title: The last line, and the bacon
